checkpoints.summary: Inspected live repository, reconciled HEAD 8273870 with the prompt's reported ef96741 baseline, terminated stale dev watchers causing OOM, and created canonical state/plan artifacts.

Re-executed all locally runnable gates. Typecheck 35/35, lint 32/32 (0 errors, 259 warnings), tests 47/47 tasks / 361 tests, forced build 29/29, audit PASS after fix, db:check PASS, ops:test PASS, format PASS. DB integration/E2E/containers/restore remain blocked.
Updated implementation state, gap matrix, final status and deployment readiness with executed evidence; recorded the body-parser fix and question-bank pagination work.
Committed 18 files as 84f0d58. Push not performed because the repository uses pull-request merges into main.

Added parent dashboard and hardened the parent service; replaced hardcoded localhost API origins in 16 web pages with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL; made dashboard links functional and role-aware. Web typecheck/lint/build pass; parents build/test(8)/lint pass.
Committed parent dashboard, parents-service hardening and web API-origin fix as bc9f844.

Hardened services/users and services/organizations: whitelisted profile/organization updates (rejecting role, organizationId, email, code, type), self/teaching/admin read checks, organization-scoped list/get/update, clamped pagination, resolveConnectionString, closeDb. Added 12 policy tests. Full gates pass: 107 tasks, 380 tests, 32 files.
Committed users/organizations security hardening and documentation updates as 72e5caa. Push not performed because the repository uses pull-request merges into main.

Moved token storage to httpOnly access/refresh cookies; web client keeps access token in memory and refreshes via httpOnly refresh cookie; added logout endpoint; shared RBAC/identity middleware accept access cookie; gateway CORS credentials enabled. Full gates pass: 107 tasks, 380 tests, 32 files.
Committed token-storage hardening and documentation updates as e5ed1ee. Push not performed because the repository uses pull-request merges into main.
Added useOfflineSync queue flush and wired offline assignment submit/lesson completion; full gates pass (107 tasks, 380 tests, 32 files).
Added minimal admin console page with users/organizations/audit views; full gates pass (107 tasks, 380 tests, 32 files).
Added admin console skip-link accessibility baseline; web typecheck/build pass; docs/state updated.

Implemented gateway rate-limit topology: the in-process store is explicitly single-replica and startup validation rejects GATEWAY_REPLICA_COUNT>1 with memory; added an atomic Postgres shared store, migration 0004 for rate_limit_windows, and closed audit_logs.hash/previous_hash schema drift. Full gates pass: typecheck 35/35, lint 32/32 (0 errors), tests 49/49 tasks / 389 tests / 32 files, build 29/29, audit PASS (1 moderate dev-only), db:check 5 migrations, ops:test and format PASS.
Committed the rate-limit topology work as ce3d24e. Push not performed because the repository uses pull-request merges into main.

Restored the missing services/search/src/normalize.ts that db.ts and handlers.ts already imported, fixing the broken search build. Added bounded whitespace/AND tokenization, Bengali digit/zero-width/nukta normalization, LIKE escaping, type/sort/locale/pagination parsing and 21 unit tests. Documented search query parameters and updated the TODO/plan. Full gates pass: typecheck 36/36, lint 32/32 (0 errors), tests 50/50 tasks / 410 tests / 33 files, forced build 29/29, db:check 5 migrations consistent.

Upgraded Next.js 15.5.28 to 16.4.3 with React/React DOM 19.3.1 and React 19 types. Removed the Next.js 16-removed `next lint` command in favor of ESLint 9 flat config, migrated middleware.ts to the proxy convention, and configured the Turbopack workspace root. Kept legacy package linting on ESLint 8 via a root devDependency so existing .eslintrc files remain valid. Verified typecheck 36/36, lint 32/32 (0 errors), tests 50/50 tasks, and both default and standalone Turbopack production builds.

Implemented the content gaps around personal learning state using the existing learning_objectives/lesson_objectives/lesson_bookmarks/lesson_notes tables (no new migration needed). Added org-scoped DB queries, a pure policy module with 17 unit tests, handlers and routes for course/lesson objectives (teacher-owner or admin mutations) and student-only bookmarks and notes (caller-pinned, trimmed 20k limit). Fixed offline queue writes so enqueued work is actually persisted, and added bookmark/note controls with offline enqueue to the lesson learn page. Verified content build + lint (0 errors), web typecheck + lint (0 errors) + Next.js production build, workspace typecheck 36/36 and tests 50/50.
Merged commit 4e2b6bd: added a keyboard-visible skip link, small-screen public navigation without horizontal overflow, visible focus rings and an accessible home label in PublicShell.
Merged commit 4c0c44b / dc3616c: quiz submission now enqueues through the shared offline queue when the API is unreachable, reports an offline-saved message and flushes on reconnect.

Implemented the teacher lesson editor at /teacher/courses/[id]/lessons/[lessonId], fixing the broken Edit link from the lessons list. The page loads lesson, course objectives and linked objectives in parallel; edits title/description/type/order/duration/JSON content/published state; and supports course-objective create/edit/delete plus lesson link/unlink with loading, unauthorized, empty, error, retry, validation and success states. Hardened PUT /lessons/:id with a pure parseLessonUpdate policy that whitelists allowed fields, ignores courseId/moduleId/deletedAt, bounds text, validates lesson types and requires object JSON content, with 5 new policy tests. Reconciled PROGRESS_STATE with merged checkpoints 18-19 and refreshed stale content/offline docs.

Closed a cross-tenant IDOR in @edunet/analytics: all four course-analytics routes now require organization context, look up the course inside that organization, and allow only the owning teacher or a same-organization administrator (404 for missing/out-of-org, 403 for non-owners). Every query is org-scoped and excludes soft-deleted courses, enrollments, assignments and submissions, and the service uses the lazy getDb() client. Added a pure policy module (UUID, ownership, bounded days, score percent) with 11 tests plus 8 handler tests for tenant/ownership/validation paths. Added /teacher/courses/:id/analytics with summary, grading progress, engagement, assignment and student performance views and linked it from the course page. The summary now returns averagePercent. Workspace typecheck 36/36, tests 51/51, lint 32/32; analytics/web lint have no errors.

Fixed attendance authorization and privacy. Marking now checks attendance:write (teachers previously failed an academics:write check), list/summary require attendance:read, and every query is role-scoped: admins see the organization, teachers only homeroom/taught classes, students themselves, parents linked children with canViewAttendance, and other roles are denied. Marking now requires an active class in the organization, actively enrolled students, rejects duplicate students and validates section ownership. Class rosters are staff-only and teacher-scoped; /academics/classes?mine=true filters teacher classes. Added 13 handler tests plus policy assertions (platform 39/39) and a /teacher/attendance page with class/date selection, roster status entry, counts and save states, linked from the teacher dashboard.

Added the student/parent attendance surface at /attendance. Students see their own records; parents select a linked child. The page offers 30/90/365-day ranges, attendance-rate and status counts, a records table with class names and notes, and loading/error/retry/empty/unauthorized states. Added a shared readApiError helper and linked attendance from the student dashboard, parent dashboard and parent portal.

Added /offline/queue for conflict triage and queue management: summary counts, per-action state/attempts/next-retry, payload review, retry all/retry one (clearing backoff) and discard with confirmation. The offline package records lastError/lastStatus, clears them on retry, and tests failure metadata plus 409 capture; useOfflineSync now surfaces server error messages/status and broadcasts queue changes for live banner/page updates. Linked the queue from the offline banner and offline page, and updated dashboard/parent links.

Added /library for students: lists bookmarks and private notes across enrolled courses, with search, course links, delete actions, confirmation for notes, and loading/error/empty/success states. Linked from the student dashboard and My Courses header.

Extended offline support: useOfflineSync now background-syncs on reconnect, page visibility and a 30-second interval; flushQueue automatically drops pending edits superseded by a newer same-entity edit (last-write-wins) via dedupeQueue. Added LAST_WRITE_WINS_TYPES and 4 dedupe tests (offline suite 25/25). Full gates pass.

Extended /api/search with facets (`?facets=1` returns per-type counts; single types respond `{ items, facets }`, `all` gains a `facets` field) and an opt-in trigram fuzzy-matching path gated behind `SEARCH_USE_TRIGRAM=true` and migration `0005_trigram_search.sql` (pg_trgm extension + GIN trigram indexes), with LIKE fallback. Added config validation + test, `parseBoolean` + `trigramEnabled` + tests (search suite 28/28).

Added /search UI page: calls GET /api/search with q/type/facets, renders grouped results for "all" and flat lists for single types, shows facet counts (courses by subject, people by role), loading/error/empty states, and links to courses. Linked Search from all role dashboards.
